records.text: The unreleased Epstein tapes are child pornography and do not show third parties with underage people on Epstein Island.
records.speaker: Ben Shapiro

appearances.snippet: There are, by the way, but they are child pornography. The reason the FBI is not releasing them is because those tapes do not include underage people with third parties on Epstein Island.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. The DOJ/FBI memorandum describes a large volume of illegal child sexual-abuse material and pornography in the holdings and says review found no evidence that could predicate investigation of uncharged third parties. Reporting on the reviewed videos likewise found no depiction of third parties abusing victims. The statement is supported as a description of the reviewed holdings, while victim privacy prevents public inspection of the material itself.

sources.title: DOJ/FBI Memorandum on Epstein Investigative Holdings (July 2025)
sources.relevance: Primary source describing the volume and nature of seized material and the review's finding concerning uncharged third parties.

records.text: Howard Lutnick and his family were on Epstein Island in 2012, after Epstein pleaded guilty to state charges.
records.speaker: Jared Moskowitz

appearances.snippet: But now the files are public, ... and in 2012 we found out that he and his family are on Epstein Island. ... after Epstein pled guilty to state charges.

verification.notes: Associated Press reporting based on released records and congressional questioning confirms Howard Lutnick and his family visited Epstein's private island in 2012, after Epstein's 2008 guilty plea.
